questoes.enunciado: Identify the outlined structure in this image.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Rough endoplasmic reticulum is well developed in this cell and appears as multiple, stacked cisterns. The electron-dense staining is due to the presence of ribosomes attached to the cytoplasmic surface of the membranes.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The Golgi apparatus consists of flattened membranous sacs (cisterns) and vesicles and is usually located near the nucleus. Though resembling rough endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi is distinguished by the lack of ribosomes. Multiple Golgi are present in this cell.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Glycogen granules are highly electron-dense structures in the cytoplasm. They readily aggregate into clusters, as seen in this liver cell and would stain positively with the periodic-Schiff stain (PAS) by light microscopy. Glycogen granules are not surrounded by a membrane.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the X's.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Lipid droplets can be found throughout the cytoplasm, occurring singly or in groups. Their contents appear grainy with moderate electron density due to the osmium fixation. Lipid droplets are not surrounded by a membrane and thus coalescence with neighboring droplets.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the circle.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The nucleolus is located within the nucleus and is not surrounded by a membrane. It consists of DNA, RNA and protein and is the site of initial ribosome synthesis. Highly active cells can have multiple nucleoli.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Secretory vesicles are distinct, membrane-enclosed structures in the cytoplasm of secretory cells. In the exocrine pancreas, shown here, large numbers of secretory granules accumulate at the apex of the cell. Secretory granules can vary in their staining properties, depending on the contents of the granules.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Mitochondria are composed of an inner and an outer membrane, the inner membrane has shelf-like or tubular folds called cristae. Mitochondrial shape and size can be highly variable and reflects the metabolic requirements of the cell. It is estimated that each liver cell (seen here) has over 800 mitochondria.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This electron micrograph of a pancreatic acinus shows secretory granules in the apex of the cell and the rough endoplasmic reticulum and nucleus at the base. Secretory granules are surrounded by a membrane and their contents appear uniformly electron dense. Secretory granules can range in size from 0.50 to 2 microns in diameter.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Polysomes, or polyribosomes, are clusters of ribosomes arranged as circles or spirals, which are threaded onto a single messenger RNA molecule (not resolved in this image). Ribosomes are electron dense and approximately one-fourth the size of glycogen granules. Proteins synthesized on polysomes are used within the cell.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: The nuclear envelope is composed of two unit membranes, the inner and outer nuclear membranes enclosing a perinuclear space. The outer membrane is continuous with the endoplasmic reticulum and often possesses ribosomes on its cytoplasmic surface. The nuclear envelope is not continuous; it is interrupted by nuclear pores allowing bidirectional transport between the nucleus and cytoplasm.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. In this cell the rough endoplasmic reticulum is not well developed and appears as single, isolated cisterns. The electron-dense staining is due to the presence of ribosomes attached to the cytoplasmic surface of the membranes.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Chromatin is a complex of protein and DNA within the nucleus. Heteochromatin is electron dense and transcriptionally less active than the more electron lucent, euchromatin which is transcriptionally active. Heterochromatin is frequently distributed in a perinuclear distribution immediately beneath the nuclear envelope.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: The diplosome consists of two centrioles at right angles to each other. During S phase of the cell cycle, the centrioles of the diplosome duplicate, forming two diplosomes which migrate to opposite sides of the nucleus during prophase. The diplosomes produce the mitotic spindle.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Smooth endoplasmic reticulum, well developed in this steroid-secreting cell, consists of a membranous network of tubules lacking ribosomes. Smooth endoplasmic reticulum is distinguished from the Golgi, which also has smooth membranes, but is organized as stacks of cisternae. SER is the major site of lipid and cholesterol synthesis.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cytoskeletal element seen in these images.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Actin filaments form stress fibers that form a complex network throughout the cytoplasm to provide support for the cell and its processes. Microfilaments are also concentrated beneath the plasma membrane and supporting microvilli.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cytoskeletal elements indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Microtubules are the hollow only cytoskeletal element, shaped like a soda straw. They provide a network within the cell for intracellular transport. In dividing cells, microtubules form the mitotic spindle. In addition, microtubules form aggregate structures, centrioles, basal bodies and the axoneme of cilia and flagella.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Glycogen granules are present in most cells, but are highly abundant in these liver cells. Due to the carbohydrate in these granules, they react positively with the periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) stain seen here.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the double arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Lysosomes are organelles that contain hydrolytic enzymes and are surrounded by a single membrane. The contents of a lysosome can appear highly heterogeneous depending on the type of material that is being broken down. Lysosomes form by the fusion of Golgi-derived, pre-lysosomal vesicles with either internalized materials or autophagosomes.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the specific stage indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Prophase is the initial phase of mitosis. The replicated chromosomes are highly condensed and clearly evident, appearing randomly distributed. The nuclear envelope and nucleolus have disappeared at this stage. During prophase, diplosomes migrate to opposite poles of the nucleus.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The nucleolus is highly basophilic and is located within the nucleus. The nucleolus stains heavily with hematoxylin due to its large quantity of DNA and RNA. It appears smooth and spherical, though not surrounded by a membrane. Heterochromatin is also basophilic, but is distributed throughout the nucleus and varies in size. The paler-blue region surrounding the nucleolus is the highly euchromatic nucleus.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The term plasma membrane refers only to the membrane at the cell surface. The structure of the plasma membrane and intracellular membranes is similar.

questoes.enunciado: What term best describes the shape of the cells indicated by the double arrows?

alternativas.feedback: Columnar cells are shaped like columns and, as such, are much taller than they are wide. Here, a single row of columnar cells lines a kidney tubule. The lateral cell boundaries are also visible in this image.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This high magnification electron micrograph shows ribosomes aligned along the cytoplasmic surface of the membranes of the endoplasmic reticulum, forming rough endoplasmic reticulum. Ribosomes are electron dense, as are glycogen granules, however the latter are larger and not associated with membranes.

questoes.enunciado: What term best describes the staining properties of the structure indicated by the arrows?

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Accumulations of rough endoplasmic reticulum stain with hematoxylin and thus are basophilic. The basophilia results from the ribosomes located along the membranes of the rough endoplasmic reticulum. Also stained is heterochromtin within the nucleus.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrow.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The nucleolar organizing centers of the nucleolus are the most pale staining regions of the nucleolus. They are sites of active DNA transcription of ribosomal RNA genes.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrow.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Euchromatin is highly dispersed, DNA and, as such, stains highly electron-lucent. Euchromatin indicates areas of active DNA transcription. The nuclei of most cells contain a mixture of euchromatin and heterochromatin. The nucleus of this highly active liver cell appears almost entirely euchromatic.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the specific stage indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Paired sister chromatids are tightly aligned in the center of the cell forming the metaphase plate. Though not visible in these examples, the spindle apparatus composed of microtubules are present, as are two diplosomes at opposite ends of the spindle.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This image of a neuron shows large accumulations of rough endoplasmic reticulum which in this nerve cell is specifically referred to as Nissl substance. The rough endoplasmic reticulum is highly basophilic but is usually not visible at the light microscopic level unless it occurs in large accumulations, as seen here.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the specific stage indicated by the oval.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This is mid-anaphase. During anaphase, chromosomes separate and migrate towards the diplosome by the action of microtubules of the spindle fibers. In early anaphase chromosomes separate and migrate. Late anaphase occurs when chromosomes have aggregated at the poles in the forming daughter cells.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

The outer membrane is continuous with the endoplasmic reticulum and often possesses ribosomes on its cytoplasmic surface. The nuclear envelope is not continuous; it is interrupted by nuclear pores allowing bidirectional transport between the nucleus and cytoplasm.
